evidence.detail: The base-to-target product changes are confined to the approved ISSUE-0007 paths: auth.py, tests/test_auth.py, README.md, and docs/security-boundaries.md. Additional changes are governance records.

Two focused tests assert the exact constant and decoded request-body scope. The complete auth test module passed independently: 22 tests, exit 0.

The required full-suite command discovered 85 tests but exited 1 because all 22 server integration tests were denied permission to bind a loopback socket. The remaining 63 tests completed without reported failures.
The required compile command exited 1 because the read-only checkout prevented creation of __pycache__.
The governance validator exited 1 because no writable temporary directory was available for launcher smoke tests.
The exact base-to-target diff passes whitespace validation.

The committed handoff records out-of-band successful checks at the candidate: 85 tests passed, compile exited 0, and repository validation passed. This author-provided record cannot replace independent execution under the review rules.
